source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Enter registration number.
3. Enter vehicle inspection date, time of the test and location in remarks box (bottom left hand corner of the report).
4. Enter brake test results.
   * Under mass, try these first.
     # 10 (or 10) - for 40-60% results
     # 20 - for less than 40%
     # 30 - for more than 60%
5. Enter the relevant failure code on report. For a balanced brake test failure which also displays an advisory the two relevant failure codes should be both entered (separate them with the dash character).
6. Add details of the problem in the remarks box (top right hand corner of
report)
7. The other axle or axles can be carried out as a pre-test rather than for a full test (this will also work on the brake test record you
